remarks:
Welcome to 25 Alpine Place!
Nestled in a desirable family-friendly neighborhood, this charming and versatile home offers comfort, space, and excellent potential. The layout features two bedrooms upstairs and a spacious main-level bedroom conveniently located near the front entrance, along with a bright living room, formal dining area, a large kitchen, and one full bathroom.
Recently refreshed with new paint and updated flooring, this move-in-ready home blends modern improvements with timeless character. Inside, you’ll find generously sized bedrooms, ample storage space, and great potential for future customization to fit your needs.
Step outside to enjoy a private and spacious backyard, along with a large driveway and detached one-car garage — perfect for relaxing, entertaining, or providing additional parking. Conveniently located close to schools, shopping centers, restaurants, and public transportation, this property is an excellent opportunity for both owner-occupants and investors seeking strong rental potential.
Don’t miss the opportunity to make this delightful home yours.
